description: Returns the current fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies: the price in GEL of one unit of each product. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, or gas at a company today, or to compare companies. Each product has a grade that every company shares: regular (litre), premium (litre), super (litre), super_100 (litre), diesel (litre), cng (cubic_metre), lpg (litre), other (litre). price: the price in GEL of one unit at a station with an attendant. self_service_price: the price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the same company. A product with no self_service_price has none. The fuel companies of this server: connect (Connect, publishes no effective date), gulf (Gulf), lukoil (Lukoil), neogas (Neogas, publishes no effective date), portal (Portal, publishes no effective date), rompetrol (Rompetrol, publishes no effective date), socar (SOCAR, publishes no effective date), wissol (Wissol). The prices are of today. The tool has no history.

companies.description: Fuel company codes. Empty asks every company. The description of the tool lists the codes.

grades.description: Grades: regular, premium, super, super_100, diesel, cng, lpg, other. Empty asks every grade.

language.description: The language of the product names: ka or en. The default is en.

name: fuel_get_prices

companies.description: The prices of each fuel company that answered, sorted by company code.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the prices, RFC 3339. The company publishes no instant.

missing.description: The requested grades that the company does not sell.

prices.description: The prices of the products, sorted by grade.

effective_date.description: The date from which the company applies the prices, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent when the company publishes no date: as_of then gives the age of the price.

grade.description: The grade of the product, the same for every company.

price.description: The standard price in GEL of one unit, as a decimal string.

product.description: The name of the product at the company.

self_service_price.description: The price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the company, as a decimal string. Absent when the company publishes none.

unit.description: The unit of each price: litre, or cubic_metre for cng.

source.description: The name of the fuel company.

stale.description: True when the company did not answer and the server returns prices it read before.

meaning.description: How to read price and self_service_price.

unavailable.description: The fuel companies that did not answer.

source.description: The name of the fuel company.

title: Fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies
